tickets.title: Prepare month-by-month tuition schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month‑by‑month schedule for Mira Quillwhistle showing how Marzipan Meadow College charges will be funded from Elin’s 529 balance, the $21,000 Teacup Comet tuition set‑aside, and the Paper Otter Treasury reserve without altering retirement contributions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain itemized billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF billing packet for Marzipan Meadow College for Mira Quillwhistle to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve 529 balance mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the balance discrepancy for Mira Quillwhistle’s Elin 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, where the mobile screenshot shows $67,400 but the statement shows $72,270.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to resolve the balance mismatch by December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify payment workflow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for Mira Quillwhistle to use with the Marzipan Meadow College portal after the bank verification was rejected.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to identify the payment or reimbursement workflow by December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate education funding projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using the existing 529 balance, anticipated test and application costs, and a first‑year college savings target that avoids borrowing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to prepare that projection by December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan cost‑gap estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a cost‑gap estimate for Rowan Quillwhistle to compare merit aid offers, based on the scholarship response calendar and anticipated expenses before the first school deposit decision.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to prepare the cost‑gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare off‑campus housing projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection for Elin Quillwhistle’s off‑campus housing costs—including rent, food, and utilities—and assess how they fit within the education funding plan and parent cash flow.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare sale‑sequencing and tax estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a sale‑sequencing plan and tax estimate for Mira Quillwhistle to use the Paper Otter taxable account’s education reserve, considering unrealized gains and the Treasury position earmarked for tuition.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow‑up is to prepare the sale‑sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
